Overview.Name: Bhagyasree G
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Feeling energetic & confident, Preventing/reversing health issues, Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal, avoids non-veg on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + sautéed vegetables
Option 2: RICE RAWA upma (~150 g) + curd
Option 3: Paneer cubes (120 g) + cucumber slices
Meal_2 (Main Meal): Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (120 g) & vegetable curry
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & paneer curry (120 g) & vegetable fry
Option 3: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & egg curry (2 eggs) & curd
Meal_3 (Dinner - balanced): Option 2: Vegetable soup + paneer cubes (80 g)
Option 3: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Follow vegetarian meals on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday and Saturday.
Stress eating can increase cravings, so avoid long gaps between meals.
Start meals with eggs, paneer or curd before eating rice.
Morning sunlight exposure can improve energy, recovery and sleep quality.
Consistent yoga and simple home-cooked meals will help maintain steady energy levels.
